column1: # Calendar trades: Antoine's amendment to the append-only calendar, read by
# scripts/build-calendar.ts. Each row swaps the words of two days, both still to
# come on the day the trade was made, so it re-dates those two days and no
# other. Applied in order they take the calendar as the generator built it to
# the one committed; undone in reverse they take it back. The build refuses a
# committed calendar this record does not undo cleanly, and
# build-calendar.test.ts pins the result. The Swift app pins the same file.
# A trade never touches a past or present day. A row is never edited or
# removed once shipped: a later change is a new row.
# Columns: made, first day, the word it takes, second day, the word it takes,
# reason. Days are YYYY-MM-DD, counted from the calendar's epoch.
